ci.command: docker buildx build --load --cache-from type=gha,scope=talkie-frontend --cache-to type=gha,mode=max,scope=talkie-frontend -f apps/frontend/Dockerfile --build-arg GIT_COMMIT={args.gitCommit} --build-arg BUILD_DATE={args.buildDate} -t {args.username}/talkie-frontend:{args.tag} .

options.command: docker tag {args.username}/talkie-frontend:{args.tag} {args.username}/talkie-frontend:latest && docker push {args.username}/talkie-frontend:{args.tag} && docker push {args.username}/talkie-frontend:latest
